source: Own measurement, 2026-11-06: the token-privileged reference expert (solution/solve.sh, which installs solution/solver.py at sha256 72ccc04a942ac303 and footprints.json 00c5e2073b1c2002 with the oracle token) through this build's verify on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json, sha256 e81a092eb6e2ca55), in one fresh container of the task image (ale-framework:c803df660b128dc54c63d9d48cca95b5, sha256:3c47ea687174; one RTX 4090, driver 580.178.04, 8 cores, 32 GB, no network) run the way the separate verifier runs it (tests/review/regrade.sh; run pr24t2-g4-spy, 377 s): the submission root-owned with no setup and no ~/drive, tests/ root-only, test.sh as root, the verdict through ROBOTICS_GRADER_VERDICT_PATH. One verify, as the owner asked (2026-11-06: a test runs once); its run.sh also started the leak audit's spy beside the expert (tests/review/spy/), which only records. 24 of 24 episodes completed with no collision, no hazard hit, no red light and no abort; route_completion 0.9779, pace 0.7986, episode scores 0.7224-1.0000; privileged_mode 1, layout_checked 1, the match lock held (27 of 62 probe pairs moved). ale validate's oracle pass on this commit is the maintainers' to record.
note: Measured, not drawn: every submission meets the same 24 episodes. CARLA 0.9.15 does not repeat an episode bit for bit (a one-ulp split in its vehicle physics about 10 ticks in, even in a fresh process), so the scores move a little from run to run: against the selection run of the same episodes (tests/hidden/selection.json, the same expert and grader), 11 of the 24 episode scores are equal to 4 decimals and the others differ by at most 0.0252 (mean 0.0072); the two means are 0.914675 and 0.914330. That is the design's NONDET branch, so full_at is F1 = floor(200 * (1 - max_k s_k / sum_k s_k) / 0.995) / 200 = 0.955 from this verify (best episode 1.0000, sum 21.9439): losing any one episode, even the best one as a zero, leaves the ratio at 0.9544 or more and the reward at 0.9994, which rounds to 1.00; losing two leaves about 0.95. The pace term keeps the reference below 1: completion ends at the first route point at or past 97 %, pace counts from a standstill against the posted limit, and every full stop (behind the reversing car or the dropped cargo, at the crossing group, at red lights) costs pace and a harsh brake. Per variant: debris 0.891, walking_in_lane 0.972, shoulder_pass 0.950, spinning_car 0.903, overtaking_oncoming 0.965, reversing_car 0.875, dropped_cargo 0.874, crowd_against_light 0.884.
history: Before (2026-10): value 0.8266 with full_at 0.95, the mean of two reference-oracle runs through the engine (engine 90a7c1c, RTX 4090, driver 570.211: 0.8330 and 0.8202) on fresh draws of the graded mix, with the earlier expert, bridge and stagings; full_at was the worse run's ratio to that mean, rounded down to 0.05.
